name: USGS Water Services (NWIS)
description: Streamflow, gage height, water temperature and groundwater level from roughly 1.9 million US monitoring sites, live at 15-minute resolution and historically as daily values back to the 1890s at the oldest gauges. The instantaneous-values service is keyless JSON.

access.rate_limit: no key, but large multi-site multi-year requests are throttled
access.pagination: none - you constrain by sites, parameterCd and period instead

fields: parameterCd 00060 = discharge in cubic feet per second

probes.description: Potomac River at Little Falls, current discharge

recipes.title: Every gauge in a county with current flow

gotchas.trap: An empty result is HTTP 200 with an empty timeSeries array, and a bad site code is a 400 with an HTML body.
gotchas.fix: Check both the status and whether timeSeries is non-empty.

gotchas.trap: Provisional data is served alongside approved data and can be revised or withdrawn.
gotchas.fix: The qualifier codes (P = provisional, A = approved) are in the values array; keep them.
